## Open issues

- [#173](https://github.com/jamchen/aldus/issues/173) — Adopter neutrality is unenforced and breached twice; and the release cadence needs an ADR now that the project's mode has changed
- [#172](https://github.com/jamchen/aldus/issues/172) — Release: nothing can register the receipt artifact a publication gate must bind, so release.public is unsatisfiable by construction
- [#160](https://github.com/jamchen/aldus/issues/160) — Synthesis billing reaches no Runtime-owned CostRecord writer, so an approved USD ceiling has nothing to consume
- [#155](https://github.com/jamchen/aldus/issues/155) — Aldus lacks an atomic spend reservation and settlement protocol before paid effects
- [#154](https://github.com/jamchen/aldus/issues/154) — A stage delegating an external effect to Aldus's own machinery cannot declare how it is keyed
- [#152](https://github.com/jamchen/aldus/issues/152) — A cost store failing after the provider call has no recoverable state
- [#136](https://github.com/jamchen/aldus/issues/136) — A take cannot say who delivered the bytes, and 'authorized' is being read as 'paid'
- [#107](https://github.com/jamchen/aldus/issues/107) — AgentResult has no cost channel, so a backend that knows what it spent cannot say so

## Not measured, and not measurable here
